description: The Halifax tender portal returned HTTP 200 and supplied a committed capture. In parallel, check whether the live SQLite page gives a prospective buyer enough information to request the proposed CAD 75 diagnosis by plain text. Feedback is available as unverified interpretations, with no newly classified signal and five unclassified sources. Demand and attribution remain unknown. Treasury shows CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. Paid acceptance still depends on a real eligible inquiry and administrative approval.
